name: Haramase Shuugaku Ryokou ~Souda, Kozukuri ni Ikou~
original_name: 孕ませ修学旅行～そうだ、子作りに行こう～
source:
A new highly specialized academy has opened.
Its specialty is taking youth and turning it into pregnant youth.
Experts have composed the curricu-cum for maximum impregnation.
The girls will take a heart-pounding, hip-bucking 3 day trip...
To get knocked up in that sweet spot! 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE069483.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一所新的高度专业化的学院已经开业。
它的特点是把青春变成怀孕的青春。
专家们制定了最大限度地渗透的课程。
女孩们将进行一次令人心跳加速、扭臀的三天旅行……
在那个甜蜜的地方被击倒！
